description: ONS documents the use of NEWAVE and DECOMP in Brazilian energy-operation planning. Its 2013 account describes the PEN assessment, future-cost coupling and the adoption of CVaR risk aversion in NEWAVE version 18. The provider is Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico. Coverage: The application concerns Brazil’s interconnected system and the 2013 assessment of supply conditions through 2017. Reported capacities and deficit risks are dated planning assumptions and results. Access: The official 2013 reporting page was read. Operational input files, software and output series were not obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Future capacity and low deficit-risk results are model projections from 2013. They do not establish realised 2017 performance or the current methodology. For simulation it provides an operational example of linking long- and short-term stochastic electricity models. Related resources: The separately prepared NEWAVE item describes the model; this record describes a dated application and is not a duplicate of the software.
